title: Graphic Designer (AI Image Editing & Photo Retouching)
description:

**Experience Required:**
3–4 Years Minimum
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position:**
Graphic Designer – AI Image Editing & Visual Quality Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**creative, detail-oriented, and experienced Graphic Designer**
with strong expertise in AI-powered image editing, professional photo retouching, product image manipulation, and visual content creation.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have an
**exceptional eye for detail**
, the ability to identify even minor differences between AI-generated images and original product photographs, and the technical skills to deliver highly realistic, accurate, and professional-quality visuals.
  
  
The candidate should also possess good English communication skills, strong time management abilities, and the discipline to maintain daily work trackers and meet project deadlines.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* AI Image Editing & Enhancement: Create, edit, refine, and enhance AI-generated images using advanced AI tools and professional editing software.
* Product Image Accuracy: Compare AI-generated or edited images with original product references to identify and correct differences in shape, size, proportions, colours, textures, branding, and product details.
* Professional Photo Retouching: Perform high-quality photo manipulation, background removal, object replacement, colour correction, lighting adjustments, shadow creation, and realistic image compositing.
* Visual Quality Inspection: Identify missing elements, image distortions, unnatural details, alignment issues, and visual inconsistencies before final delivery.
* Creative Design: Develop visually appealing social media creatives, promotional graphics, marketing banners, advertisements, and product visuals.
* AI Prompting Skills: Write and refine effective AI image-generation prompts to achieve accurate and consistent visual outputs.
* Quality Control: Ensure every design meets client requirements, brand guidelines, and professional quality standards.
* Work Tracking & Reporting: Maintain daily work sheets using Excel or Google Sheets, including assigned tasks, progress, revisions, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Communication & Coordination: Communicate clearly in English, understand project briefs, coordinate with team members, and provide timely work updates.
* Timely Delivery: Handle multiple projects efficiently while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and deadlines.

**Required Skills & Expertise**

* Graphic Design & Photo Editing
* Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills (mandatory).
* Strong expertise in photo retouching and image manipulation.
* Product photo editing and realistic compositing.
* Background removal, object replacement, and image enhancement.
* Excellent understanding of lighting, shadows, perspective, proportions, and colour matching.
* AI Image Editing & Generation
* Hands-on experience with AI image generation and editing tools.
* Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT Image Generation, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or similar platforms.
* Strong AI prompting and image refinement skills.
* Ability to correct AI-generated image errors while preserving original product details.
* Experience creating photorealistic product and marketing visuals.
* Attention to Detail & Quality
* Exceptional observation and visual comparison skills.
* Ability to identify small inaccuracies in edited images.
* Strong understanding of product accuracy and brand consistency.
* Ability to deliver polished, realistic, high-resolution images.
* Communication & Work Management
* Good written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to understand English design briefs and revision instructions.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for daily work tracking.
* Strong organisational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum 3–4 years of professional graphic design experience.
* Proven experience in advanced Photoshop editing and photo manipulation.
* Practical experience with AI image editing and generation tools.
* Previous experience with product photography editing, advertising creatives, or digital marketing design is preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating photo retouching, product manipulation, AI image editing, and creative design work is mandatory.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
We want a designer who does not just create attractive images but also
**thinks critically, notices what others miss, and ensures every detail is accurate.**
The ideal candidate should be able to look at an AI-generated image and immediately identify:
  
  

* What is missing compared to the original product?
* Which product details have been changed incorrectly?
* Are the proportions, perspective, lighting, and shadows realistic?
* Does the final image meet the original brief and quality expectations?

**Accuracy, creativity, attention to detail, and accountability are essential for this role.**
How to Apply
  
  
**Interested Candidates Should Share**

* Updated CV / Resume
* Portfolio of previous graphic design work
* Samples of AI image editing and professional photo retouching
* Current CTC, Expected CTC, and Notice Period

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical image-editing test to demonstrate their Photoshop skills, AI editing expertise, product accuracy, and attention to detail.

Graphic Designer

Graphic Designer
